= char-refs(1)
:doctype: manpage

== NAME

char-refs - inline character references

== SYNOPSIS

Inline substitutions work in all builds.

== DESCRIPTION

P01 pass:c,r[&#169;] / pass:r,c[&#169;] / pass:c[&#169;].

P02 pass:r[&amp;#169;] / pass:c,r[&amp;#169;].

P03 pass:c,r[\&#169; \\&#169; &#9; &#0000169;].

P04 pass:c,r[&lt;tag&gt; &amp;] / pass:r,c[&lt;tag&gt; &amp;].

P05 pass:normal[&#169;] / pass:specialcharacters,replacements[&#169;].
